name: Hunter x Hunter · Powers
description: Learn the Nen language of Hunter x Hunter: the principles, the six types and the signature abilities.

seals.title: Six Types of Nen
seals.note: The six Nen types, from Emission to Specialization.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Every Nen user's basic defence: it keeps aura from leaking out of the body.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Gon and Killua; stops the flow of aura to hide their presence.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Wing and Killua; intensifies aura output to show raw power.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Killua; projects aura to create a unique Nen ability of his own.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Gon; focuses aura into the eyes to see hidden Nen, like Bungee Gum.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Nobunaga; spreads aura into a sphere to sense movement around him.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Gon and Killua; wraps an object in aura to strengthen it.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Gon; a long defensive state with about ten times the aura of Ten.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Biscuit and Feitan; pours aura into one body part for a powerful blow.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Strengthens the body and objects with aura; Gon is an Enhancer.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Changes the nature of aura; Killua's main affinity is Transmutation.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Shoots aura outward as bullets or beams; Franklin fires Nen bullets.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Creates objects from aura; Kurapika conjures his chains.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Controls living things or objects with aura; Illumi controls people.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Unique abilities that do not fit one type; Pakunoda is a Specialist.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Gon's rock-paper-scissors Nen attack; Rock is the full-power punch.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Hisoka's sticky, stretchy gum, used to reattach his own arms.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Hisoka; blends seams and names into a surface, hiding them in plain sight.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Kurapika; a vow-chain that forbids a bound foe from using Nen.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Killua; a burst of speed that let him dodge a Royal Guard's clone.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Killua; a palm strike that shocks his foe and stuns them briefly.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Illumi; people with needles in them who act on his orders.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Kurapika; chains that restrain a foe, used to capture Uvogin.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Kurapika; a chain that can find a person he has met, even on video.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Zeno; breaks his aura dragon apart so its shards rain on the palace.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Shizuku; a conjured vacuum cleaner named Blinky that cleans up the scene.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Pakunoda; conjured bullets that implant memories into their target.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Uvogin's signature punch, which knocked out Worm first.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Genthru; a deadly Nen ability he used to kill Jispa.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Killua; used the Rhythm Echo to close in on Sub before shocking him.

cards.label: nen
cards.hook: Machi; Nen threads that can control guns and other objects.
